visualCharacteristics.purpose: gallery of square images in a 4/2/1 responsive grid
visualCharacteristics.description: 8 look-alike image items in a 4-column grid that wraps (4/2/1) - repeating structure, so Cards.

contentPattern.structure: one row per image: (1) image; (2) optional caption (empty cells are dropped)

usage: Photo galleries with look-alike image tiles.
reuseGuidance: Use for image-only tiles; use cards-article when tiles carry tags, dates and links.
